items.description: Amount of time spent interacting with patient
items.grading_rubric: 1 point per full minute spent interacting with patient, up to a maximum of 20 points

items.description: Expression of empathy
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if any empathic statement or question is made (e.g., 'How has that been for you?' 'How has this affected you?')

items.description: Getting to know patient (hobbies, interests, how they spend time)
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if any question about hobbies, interests, or how they spend their time

items.description: Inquired about living situation
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if living situation is asked (e.g., where/with whom they live)

items.description: Asked about sources of support/family/paid or unpaid caregiver
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if any question about social support or caregivers

items.description: Functional status - feeding
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if feeding ability is addressed

items.description: Functional status - dressing
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if dressing ability is addressed

items.description: Functional status - bathing
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if bathing ability is addressed

items.description: Functional status - transferring
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if transferring ability is addressed

items.description: Functional status - toileting
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if toileting ability is addressed

items.description: Functional status - managing medications
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if medication management ability is addressed

items.description: Functional status - managing finances
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if financial management ability is addressed

items.description: Functional status - driving
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if driving ability is addressed

items.description: Functional status - using telephone
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if telephone use is addressed

items.description: Asked how patient has been managing health concerns already/what has been helpful
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if patient's current self-management strategies or what helps is discussed

items.description: Asked about patient's daily (or special) goals / what they would like clinician to help them achieve
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if any goals of what they want to be able to do are elicited

items.description: Inquired if patient has fallen in last year OR feels off balance OR has history of falls
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if any question about falls, feeling off balance, or history of falls is asked

items.description: Asked about use of assistive device (cane/walker/wheelchair)
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if any mobility aid is asked about

items.description: Asked about level of physical activity/exercise
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if activity level or exercise is discussed

items.description: Asked about recent medication changes OR performed medication reconciliation
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if recent medication changes or reconciliation are addressed

items.description: Asked about use of calcium and/or vitamin D
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if calcium or vitamin D use is asked about

items.description: Past medical history collected
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if past medical history relevant to mobility/falls is obtained

items.description: Physical exam - orthostatic vital signs
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if orthostatic vitals are measured or discussed

items.description: Physical exam - cardiovascular exam
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if a cardiovascular exam is performed or discussed

items.description: Physical exam - neurology examination (LE strength, LE sensory testing)
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if neurological exam including lower extremity assessment is discussed

items.description: Physical exam - lower extremity joint range of motion
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if LE joint range of motion is assessed

items.description: Home hazards (throw rugs, loose cords, accessible walkways)
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if ANY home hazard is asked about

items.description: Home accessibility (stairs, shower chair, grab bars, walk-in shower)
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if ANY home accessibility features are asked about

items.description: Reconciled medications / asked for medication list
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if medication list is reviewed or reconciliation is performed

items.description: Asked whether/how often patient misses medications
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if adherence (missed doses) is discussed

items.description: Asked how patient organizes medications (assistance/pill box/blister packs)
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if any question about how medications are organized or who helps

items.description: Asked about trouble getting medications (pharmacy access/affording)
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if access or cost barriers to medications are discussed

items.description: Asked if any side effects from any medication
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if side effects from medications are asked about

items.description: Asked about memory loss or memory concerns
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if memory loss or concern about memory is asked

items.description: Asked about waxing/waning mental status OR performed brief concentration test
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if fluctuation in mental status or brief concentration testing is done

items.description: Performed cognitive evaluation (Mini-Cog or MoCA or MMSE)
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if any formal cognitive screen is performed or mentioned

items.description: Asked about mood/spirits/worries/anxiety
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if mood, anxiety, or worries are discussed

items.grading_rubric: 1 point if living will or POLST is discussed

items.description: Asked about 'advanced directives' (if items 3 and 4 were not already counted)
items.grading_rubric: 1 point if advance directives are discussed AND items 3 and 4 were not already counted
